    # Populate the generated `output` dict; the save after Custom Code End emits
    # it. status follows the send action's result: success only when it sent.
    raw_output = phantom.get_run_data(key="playbook_output")
    if raw_output:
        output.update(json.loads(raw_output))
    sent = phantom.collect2(container=container, datapath=["send_isolation_email:action_result.status"])
    if sent and sent[0] and sent[0][0]:
        output["status"] = "success" if sent[0][0] == "success" else "failed"
    # The 8.6 VPE initialises every output above to [] (8.5 wrote None), so an
    # output no block set is normalised to null here, whichever form a save wrote.
    for key, value in output.items():
        if value == []:
            output[key] = None
    if output["status"] is None:
        output["status"] = "failed"

Look the user up by username for the email. launcher_rows = phantom.collect2(container=container, datapath=["playbook:launching_user.name"]) launcher = launcher_rows[0][0] if launcher_rows and launcher_rows[0] and launcher_rows[0][0] else "" recipient_email = None if launcher: try: resp = phantom.requests.get( uri=phantom.build_phantom_rest_url("ph_user") + '?_filter_username="{}"&page_size=1'.format(launcher), verify=False, ).json() users = resp.get("data") or [] recipient_email = users[0].get("email") if users else None except Exception as e: phantom.debug("Could not fetch ph_user for '{}': {}".format(launcher, str(e))) if not recipient_email: msg = "Could not resolve an email address for the user who launched the playbook ({})".format(launcher or "unknown") phantom.error(msg) phantom.add_note( container=container, note_type="general", title="TRAP Isolation Notify - Error", content=msg ) return # The prefix lives in the format block isolation_browser_url, where an # operator sets it without touching code. browser_prefix = (phantom.get_format_data(name="isolation_browser_url") or "").strip() if not browser_prefix: msg = "The isolation-browser prefix is empty: set it in the format block 'isolation browser url'." phantom.error(msg) phantom.add_note( container=container, note_type="general", title="TRAP Isolation Notify - Error", content=msg ) return # Threat URLs come from two artifacts: Threat Domain cef.url (URLs in the # emails) and URL Artifact cef.requestURL (the incident's hosts.url, often # the only ones on a real incident). scope="all" is required when # re-running on an existing container (constraints.md). A URL the mail # system already wrapped in Safe Links is unwrapped first, or the isolation # browser would go through Safe Links before reaching it; the set drops a # URL both artifacts carry. url_rows = phantom.collect2(container=container, datapath=["artifact:*.name", "artifact:*.cef.url", "artifact:*.cef.requestURL"], scope="all") or [] threat_urls = sorted({_unwrap_safelinks(url) for row in url_rows if row for name, url in (("Threat Domain", row[1]), ("URL Artifact", row[2])) if row[0] == name and url}) if not threat_urls: phantom.add_note( container=container, note_type="general", title="TRAP Isolation Notify", content="No threat URL on this case: no email sent.", note_format="markdown", ) playbook_output = json.loads(phantom.get_run_data(key="playbook_output") or "{}") playbook_output.update({"status": "skipped", "recipient_email": recipient_email, "link_count": 0}) phantom.save_run_data(key="playbook_output", value=json.dumps(playbook_output)) return # The case link is direct: it is SOAR's own page, not a target to isolate. soar_base = phantom.get_base_url() or "" container_url = "{}/mission/{}".format(soar_base, container.get("id")) targets = [("Threat URL", u) for u in threat_urls] link_items = [ '

    \n" "" ).format(html.escape(container_url, quote=True), html.escape(str(incident_id or "unknown")), "\n".join(link_items)) phantom.debug("Resolved recipient {}, {} link(s)".format(recipient_email, len(targets))) # Also saved as run data: send_isolation_email reads these keys. phantom.save_run_data(key="build_links:recipient_email", value=json.dumps(build_links__recipient_email)) phantom.save_run_data(key="build_links:subject", value=json.dumps(build_links__subject)) phantom.save_run_data(key="build_links:body", value=json.dumps(build_links__body)) playbook_output = json.loads(phantom.get_run_data(key="playbook_output") or "{}") playbook_output.update({"recipient_email": recipient_email, "link_count": len(targets)}) phantom.save_run_data(key="playbook_output", value=json.dumps(playbook_output)) ################################################################################ ################################################################################ ################################################################################

output_spec.description: success when the isolation email was sent, failed otherwise.

output_spec.name: incident_id
output_spec.description: TRAP incident ID of this container.

output_spec.description: Address the isolation links were sent to (the launching analyst's).
